name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'epic/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  release-version-integrity:
    name: Release version integrity
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      github.actor == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == github.event.repository.default_branch &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out trusted release validation
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |-
            scripts/validate-release-pr.mts
            scripts/release-github-evidence.mts
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Validate version-only release change
        env:
          GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RELEASE_PR_MODE: pre-merge
          RELEASE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node scripts/validate-release-pr.mts

  verify:
    name: Verification (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Architecture validates the exact event base/head and accepted epic history.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run policy, type, and test verification
        env:
          HVIR_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: npm run verify

  electron-smoke:
    name: Electron smoke (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run production Electron workflow
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/production
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke

      - name: Run development renderer Performance Timeline containment
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/development-performance
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:development-performance

      - name: Prove failure and interruption isolation
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:isolation

      - name: Upload bounded Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  macos-electron-smoke:
    # Temporary reduced gate: terminal-presentation, terminal-lifecycle, and capacity
    # remain available through local commands while their macOS flakes are hardened.
    name: Electron correctness (macOS arm64; temporary reduced gate)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run focused unpackaged Electron scenarios
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/macos-ci
        run: npm run smoke:macos:ci

      - name: Upload bounded macOS Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-macos-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  codeql:
    name: CodeQL analysis
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      packages: read
      security-events: write

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4.37.9
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript

      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4.37.9

  merge-acceptance:
    name: Merge acceptance
    needs:
      - release-version-integrity
      - verify
      - electron-smoke
      - macos-electron-smoke
      - codeql
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out exact head for base ancestry proof
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require one coherent CI attempt
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci-attempt-evidence.mts

      - name: Require exact candidate ancestry
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || ! "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Pull request base and head must be full commit SHAs"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$HEAD_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::Merge acceptance did not check out the exact pull request head"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::The tested pull request base is not an ancestor of its head"
            exit 1
          fi

+# hvir
+
+hvir is a desktop developer workbench for working across local and remote
+projects. It brings terminals, Git workspaces, file browsing, document
+rendering, and development-harness sessions into one Electron application.
+
+## Features
+
+- Local terminal sessions powered by `node-pty` and Ghostty Web
+- Persistent terminal layouts, splits, themes, search, recovery, and session
+  activity
+- Projects backed by local folders, Git worktrees, or SSH hosts
+- Git status, branches, fetch/pull, history, graph, diffs, blame, and commit
+  details
+- File tree operations, filename search, source viewing, syntax highlighting,
+  Markdown, CSV, JSON, images, and rendered previews
+- Web panes for project-related browser content
+- Configurable harness profiles for tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor,
+  Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Pi, and shell sessions
+- Workspace-aware document review and diagnostic/recovery surfaces
+
+## Requirements
+
+- Node.js 24 or newer
+- npm
+- Git
+- A supported desktop environment:
+  - macOS (the packaged build currently targets arm64)
+  - Linux x64 or arm64
+
+Remote projects additionally require SSH access to the target host. Native
+dependencies are rebuilt for Electron during installation.
+
+## Getting started
+
+Clone the repository, install its dependencies, and start the development
+application:
+
+```sh
+git clone <repository-url>
+cd hvir
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+
+The application opens in Electron. Use the project and workspace controls to
+add a local folder or connect to a remote SSH project.
+
+## Common commands
+
+| Command | Description |
+| --- | --- |
+| `npm run dev` | Start the Electron development application |
+| `npm run build` | Type-check and build the Electron application |
+| `npm run build:dir` | Build and create an unpacked application directory |
+| `npm run lint` | Run ESLint |
+| `npm run typecheck` | Type-check the Node and renderer projects |
+| `npm test` | Run the Vitest test suite |
+| `npm run verify` | Run seam, ADR, architecture, lint, type, and unit-test checks |
+| `npm run smoke` | Build and run the Linux Electron smoke scenarios |
+| `npm run smoke:macos` | Build and run the macOS smoke scenarios |
+| `npm run pack:mac:arm64` | Build a macOS arm64 package |
+| `npm run pack:linux:x64` | Build a Linux x64 Debian package |
+| `npm run pack:linux:arm64` | Build a Linux arm64 Debian package |
+
+Run `npm run` to see the complete list of development, packaging, acceptance,
+and project-maintenance commands.
+
+## Project structure
+
+```text
+src/
+  main/       Electron main-process services and host integrations
+  preload/    Typed, restricted renderer bridge
+  renderer/   React workbench UI
+  shared/     Contracts and types shared across process boundaries
+scripts/      Build, release, architecture, acceptance, and smoke tooling
+test/         Unit, integration, renderer, and smoke-support tests
+build/        Application icons, native resources, and packaging files
+```
+
+The application follows Electron’s process boundaries: privileged filesystem,
+Git, SSH, and process operations live in the main process, while the renderer
+accesses them through the typed preload API.
+
+## Development notes
+
+Native modules are rebuilt by the `postinstall` hook. If dependencies are
+installed with a command that skips lifecycle scripts, run the runtime setup
+explicitly:
+
+```sh
+npm run install:runtime
+```
+
+For a focused development loop, use `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and
+`npm test`. Before submitting a larger change, run `npm run verify` and the
+relevant Electron smoke or acceptance command.
+
+## Contributing
+
+Contributions should preserve the existing process-boundary contracts,
+workspace authorization rules, and test coverage. Keep changes focused, run
+the checks relevant to the affected surface, and include tests for behavioral
+changes.
